events.what: Andersen-Kashaev volume conjecture proved for one-cusped hyperbolic 3-manifolds admitting FAMED geometric triangulations, including all hyperbolic twist knots
Computer search (Regina/SnapPy) finds FAMED triangulations for all knots with at most 12 crossings and all knots with at most 23 tetrahedra
Volume conjecture proved for all hyperbolic double twist knots
Chen-Yang variant proved for large-parameter Dehn fillings of twist-knot manifolds
Neural network predicts volume from adjoint Jones polynomial; motivates a refined conjectural statement

judgement.doubts: The FAMED result concerns the Andersen-Kashaev (Teichmuller TQFT) form, which one could read as a variant of the Kashaev/colored-Jones volume conjecture; if so, the double-twist-knot preprint (2501.00225) is the case result the status rests on instead. Status, AI role and direction come out the same either way. The 2025 computer extension covers finitely many knots, so it counts as instances. The neural-network paper uses ML only for exploratory numerics and settles nothing. No expert digestion was found.

corrections.why: other: kept. FAMED proves the Andersen-Kashaev form, which may be a variant of the bullet's conjecture. Even so, 2501.00225 (all hyperbolic double twist knots) gives a case of the standard form, so partial holds.
